business_problem: Samsung needed to bring reliable generative-AI capabilities into its China smartphone lineup, covering typing, office work, voice assistance and call handling while reducing hallucinations and unstable output formatting.
solution_summary: Samsung Electronics China worked with Baidu AI Cloud to embed large-model services inside Galaxy AI experiences on mobile devices. Baidu's Qianfan model-development stack and ERNIE-based reasoning were used to support several user-facing workflows: the Samsung keyboard now rewrites and expands text in different tones, office functions transform recordings, webpages and documents into structured summaries, and Bixby gains stronger natural-language understanding for fast, current answers. The call assistant adds preconfigured call-management behavior so the phone can answer common delivery or courier calls with context-appropriate language. In practice, the architecture routes user prompts from typing, meetings, browsing and voice interactions into model inference and retrieval logic, then returns formatted results through Galaxy AI interfaces, helping Samsung deploy more consistent, multi-scenario AI assistance without rebuilding each feature separately.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Provides the large-model development and optimization environment behind Samsung's phone AI features.

solution_components.name: Voice Translation
solution_components.role: Supports multilingual and call-related voice interactions inside the mobile experience.

solution_components.name: Bixby
solution_components.role: Acts as the upgraded voice-assistant surface for natural-language queries and command execution.

solution_components.name: Galaxy AI
solution_components.role: Packages Samsung's cross-scenario AI functions for writing, office, assistant and call experiences.

data_flow: User prompts from the keyboard, meeting recordings, webpages, documents, voice commands and phone calls are sent into Galaxy AI workflows, where Qianfan-backed models interpret intent, generate rewrites or summaries, and return results to Bixby, the keyboard and call-assistant interfaces.
business_outcome: Samsung expanded Galaxy AI across text, office, voice and call scenarios, improved assistant comprehension and gave users a more practical, current and personalized mobile AI experience.
architecture_clues: The deployment spans input, office, voice assistant and call-assistant scenarios on smartphones
The office workflow extracts summaries from recordings, webpages and documents
The call assistant applies different tones and scripts based on preconfigured scenarios
The implementation focused on reducing hallucinations and unstable formatting
